facts.name: build_shell_command
facts.docstring:
Build a shell command string from user input.

DELIBERATELY VULNERABLE: wraps user input in a shell invocation
with no escaping or sanitization. This exists specifically to
test cross-function taint propagation.

facts.name: parse_config
facts.docstring:
Parse a JSON config string.

Thin wrapper around serde_json::from_str that provides no additional
validation. Tests that the deserialization sink is detected through
a cross-function call.

facts.reason: Deserialization of untrusted input can cause type-confusion or RCE

facts.docstring:
Execute a shell command.

VULNERABILITY: Command Injection
- User input flows to Command::new().arg() without sanitization
- Uses use alias: ShellCmd (= std::process::Command)
- Crosses function boundary: build_shell_command()

facts.name: load_config
facts.docstring:
Load configuration from a JSON string.

VULNERABILITY: Deserialization RCE
- User-controlled JSON is deserialized without schema validation
- serde_json::from_str can trigger arbitrary code via #[serde] tricks
